<!-- Two kinds of PR fit this repo. Delete the section you do not need. -->

## A hook row

- Hook and version:
- Exact command the runner was given (`--hook "..."`), and `--cwd` if a fixture was needed:
- Claude Code version it was paired with (`--claude-version`):
- Result file added under `results/` (the runner names it `<label>-<date>.json`):
- `RESULTS.md` regenerated by the runner: yes / no

## A new case

- Family: guard-file-tamper / destructive / git-config-exec / new family (say why)
- Source (thread, issue, write-up, or your own test) and date:
- Target: what a guard should refuse, or `must_pass` with the benign form it protects
- Fixture needed (files, history, symlinks)? If yes, the `note` field says what and `--cwd` points at it
- `python3 run.py --hook "..." --label <label>` was run against at least one hook with the new case: yes / no
